visibility.title: AI visibility
visibility.description: Whether AI search cites you and sends you readers.
visibility.methodology: AI bot fetches and AI referrals are real traffic to your site. Apps that omit the referrer cannot be counted, so this is a lower bound. Citations are a recurring sample of your tracked questions, not a record of every private AI conversation.

metrics.referralsNote: no visits yet | landed on {n} article | landed on {n} articles
metrics.fetchesNote: no pages yet | {n} page | {n} different pages
metrics.coverageHint: Every week we ask AI search engines (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity…) your tracked questions. This shows how many answers linked to your site.
metrics.referralsHint: People who reached your site by clicking a link in an AI answer. Some apps don't say where a visit came from, so the real number may be higher.
metrics.fetchesHint: How often AI companies' bots (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic…) downloaded your pages to answer from them or learn from them.

onboarding.title: Find out whether AI cites you
onboarding.description: We build the questions people ask ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude from your articles, your Google searches and your readers' questions. Every week we check them and show whether the answers link to your publication.
onboarding.pending: The first questions are ready within 24 hours. You can add your own right away.
onboarding.note: AI bot visits and readers arriving from AI show up here on their own once we record any.

upgrade.description: Citation checks are part of the Premium and Custom plans.

prompts.title: Tracked questions
prompts.description: Picked automatically and asked of AI search engines every week. Questions that no engine answers with any source are replaced after three weeks.
prompts.placeholder: What question should AI search answer?

outcome.NOT_CITED: Not cited by any of {checked} AI engines

domains.title: Who gets cited instead of you
domains.description: Sites AI links to for your tracked questions. The percentage is the share of answers that cite the site.
domains.referencesHint: Wikipedia, forums and public bodies. An article will not outrank them, but they show where AI draws from.

traffic.title: Traffic from AI
traffic.empty: No visit from AI has been recorded yet.
